#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Open Source Contributor Index — March 2026
Design Philosophy: Luminous Grid — Refined Pass
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math

# === CANVAS ===
W, H = 2400, 3400
BG = (10, 14, 28)
CARD_BG = (16, 22, 42)
CARD_BORDER = (30, 45, 80)

# === PALETTE ===
CYAN = (0, 180, 255)
CYAN_DIM = (0, 100, 160)
GREEN = (0, 220, 120)
GREEN_DIM = (0, 160, 90)
AMBER = (255, 180, 40)
WHITE = (240, 245, 255)
WHITE_DIM = (160, 170, 195)
WHITE_FAINT = (80, 90, 120)
NAVY_LIGHT = (22, 32, 58)
NAVY_MID = (18, 26, 48)
GOOGLE_ROW = (14, 28, 58)

# === FONTS ===
FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(FD + name, size)

f_hero        = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_hero_sub    = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_tag         = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 15)
f_tag_lg      = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 18)
f_section     = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 40)
f_big_num     = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 96)
f_med_num     = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 56)
f_sm_num      = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 38)
f_xs_num      = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 28)
f_metric_num  = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 60)
f_th          = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_td          = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_td_bold     = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30)
f_td_num      = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_td_num_b    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 28)
f_label       = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_label_sm    = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_mono        = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_mono_sm     = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_mono_xs     = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_footer      = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_footer_b    = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_march       = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 32)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# === HELPERS ===
def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill=CARD_BG, border=None, bw=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=border, width=bw)

def txt_r(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)
    draw.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0]), y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def txt_c(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)
    draw.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def txt_w(text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def arrow_up(x, y, s, color):
    draw.polygon([(x, y+s), (x+s//2, y), (x+s, y+s)], fill=color)

def glow_h_line(x1, x2, y, color, w=2, spread=8):
    for i in range(spread, 0, -2):
        a = max(0, min(255, int(40 * (1 - i/spread))))
        c = tuple(max(0, min(255, v * a // 255)) for v in color)
        blended = tuple(max(0, min(255, bg + (cv - bg) * a // 255)) for bg, cv in zip(BG, color))
        draw.line([(x1, y - i//2), (x2, y - i//2)], fill=blended, width=1)
        draw.line([(x1, y + i//2), (x2, y + i//2)], fill=blended, width=1)
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=color, width=w)

# === SUBTLE GRID ===
gc = (13, 17, 32)
for gx in range(0, W, 60):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill=gc, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 60):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=gc, width=1)

# === LAYOUT ===
ML = 100
MR = W - 100
CW = MR - ML

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
y = 60

# Accent line with glow
glow_h_line(ML, ML + 200, y, CYAN, 3)
y += 22

draw.text((ML, y), "MONTHLY DATA REPORT", font=f_tag, fill=CYAN)
y += 32

draw.text((ML, y), "Open Source", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 88
draw.text((ML, y), "Contributor Index", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 95

# Date + description
draw.text((ML, y), "MARCH 2026", font=f_march, fill=CYAN)
mw = txt_w("MARCH 2026", f_march)
# Vertical divider
draw.line([(ML + mw + 20, y + 4), (ML + mw + 20, y + 32)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=2)
draw.text((ML + mw + 36, y + 5), "Ranking commercial organizations by employee open source contributions on GitHub",
          font=f_label, fill=WHITE_DIM)
y += 52

draw.line([(ML, y), (MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 28

# === KEY METRICS ROW ===
metrics = [
    ("239", "Organizations Tracked", WHITE, None),
    ("2,721", "Combined Active Contributors", CYAN, None),
    ("+595", "New Contributors This Month", GREEN, None),
    ("20.3%", "Python — #1 Language", AMBER, None),
]

mw_each = CW // 4
for i, (val, label, color, _) in enumerate(metrics):
    mx = ML + i * mw_each
    if i > 0:
        draw.line([(mx, y + 2), (mx, y + 80)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
    inner_x = mx + (24 if i > 0 else 0)
    draw.text((inner_x, y), val, font=f_metric_num, fill=color)
    draw.text((inner_x, y + 68), label, font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_DIM)

y += 115
draw.line([(ML, y), (MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 35

# ============================================================
# LEADERBOARD TABLE
# ============================================================
draw.text((ML, y), "Top 10 Contributing Organizations", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
y += 56

# Columns
C_RANK = ML + 12
C_ORG  = ML + 75
C_ACT  = ML + 680
C_AD   = ML + 920
C_COM  = ML + 1200
C_CD   = ML + 1460
C_BAR  = ML + 1700
C_BARE = MR - 20

# Table header row
hy = y
rr(ML, hy - 4, CW, 40, 6, fill=NAVY_LIGHT)
draw.text((C_RANK, hy), "#", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
draw.text((C_ORG, hy), "ORGANIZATION", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_ACT + 130, hy, "ACTIVE", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_AD + 110, hy, "MoM", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_COM + 130, hy, "COMMUNITY", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_CD + 110, hy, "MoM", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_c((C_BAR + C_BARE)//2, hy, "SCALE", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
y = hy + 50

orgs = [
    (1, "Google",    548, 128, 1986, 267),
    (2, "Microsoft", 438,  74, 1189, 174),
    (3, "Red Hat",   432,  94, 1378, 193),
    (4, "AMD",       233,  66,  627, 109),
    (5, "Datadog",   221,  34,  411,  58),
    (6, "Intel",     217,  48,  707,  82),
    (7, "NVIDIA",    194,  41,  650, 106),
    (8, "SUSE",      158,  32,  353,  51),
    (9, "IBM",       140,  44,  616, 133),
    (10, "SAP",      140,  34,  378,  54),
]

ROW_H = 64
max_comm = 1986

for rank, org, active, ad, comm, cd in orgs:
    ry = y
    is_g = rank == 1

    # Row background
    if is_g:
        rr(ML, ry - 10, CW, ROW_H + 6, 10, fill=GOOGLE_ROW, border=CYAN, bw=2)
        # Subtle left accent bar
        draw.rounded_rectangle([ML, ry - 10, ML + 5, ry + ROW_H - 4], radius=3, fill=CYAN)
    elif rank % 2 == 0:
        rr(ML, ry - 10, CW, ROW_H + 6, 6, fill=(12, 17, 33))

    # Rank
    rc = CYAN if is_g else WHITE_FAINT
    rf = f_td_num_b if is_g else f_td_num
    draw.text((C_RANK, ry), f"{rank:>2}", font=rf, fill=rc)

    # Name
    nc = WHITE if is_g else (205, 215, 235)
    nf = f_td_bold if is_g else f_td
    draw.text((C_ORG, ry), org, font=nf, fill=nc)

    # Active
    ac = WHITE if is_g else (195, 205, 228)
    txt_r(C_ACT + 130, ry, f"{active:,}", font=f_td_num_b if is_g else f_td_num, fill=ac)

    # Active delta
    arrow_up(C_AD + 36, ry + 12, 12, GREEN)
    draw.text((C_AD + 54, ry + 2), f"+{ad}", font=f_td_num, fill=GREEN)

    # Community
    txt_r(C_COM + 130, ry, f"{comm:,}", font=f_td_num, fill=WHITE_DIM)

    # Community delta
    arrow_up(C_CD + 36, ry + 12, 12, GREEN_DIM)

y += 30

COL_L = ML

max_pct = 20.3

for lang, pct, color in languages:

    full_w = bar_end - bar_start
    rr(bar_start, ly + 10, full_w, 26, 13, fill=(18, 24, 44))

    rr(bar_start, ly + 10, fw, 26, 13, fill=color)
    ly += 56

ly += 12
draw.text((COL_L, ly), "Systems languages (C++ & C) account for 25.2% of contributions", font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_FAINT)

draw.text((COL_L, ly), "Python leads driven by AI/ML, data science & cloud-native tooling", font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_FAINT)

bar_w_lic = COL_LW - 20
bar_h_lic = 40
lx = COL_L

rr(lx, ly, bar_w_lic, bar_h_lic, 20, fill=(18, 24, 44))

# Draw segments from left to right with proper rounding
seg_x = lx
for i, (name, frac, color) in enumerate(licenses):

    if i == 0:

        # Square off right edge
        draw.rectangle([seg_x + seg_w - 20, ly, seg_x + seg_w, ly + bar_h_lic], fill=color)
    elif i == len(licenses) - 1:
        # Last segment: round right side
        remaining = bar_w_lic - (seg_x - lx)
        rr(seg_x, ly, remaining, bar_h_lic, 20, fill=color)
        # Square off left edge
        draw.rectangle([seg_x, ly, seg_x + 20, ly + bar_h_lic], fill=color)
    else:
        draw.rectangle([seg_x, ly, seg_x + seg_w, ly + bar_h_lic], fill=color)
    seg_x += seg_w

ly += bar_h_lic + 18

# Legend
lleg_x = COL_L
for name, frac, color in licenses:
    draw.rounded_rectangle([lleg_x, ly + 2, lleg_x + 16, ly + 16], radius=4, fill=color)
    label_text = f"{name} {int(frac*100)}%"
    draw.text((lleg_x + 24, ly - 2), label_text, font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_DIM)
    lleg_x += txt_w(label_text, f_label_sm) + 52

ly += 32
draw.text((COL_L, ly), "Enterprise-friendly permissive licenses dominate the ecosystem", font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_FAINT)

# ============================================================

rr(COL_L, ly, COL_LW, 140, 12, fill=CARD_BG, border=CARD_BORDER, bw=1)

iy += 22

card_h = 290
rr(COL_R, ry_pos, COL_RW, card_h, 14, fill=(12, 24, 52), border=CYAN, bw=2)
# Left accent
draw.rounded_rectangle([COL_R, ry_pos, COL_R + 5, ry_pos + card_h], radius=3, fill=CYAN)

cy = ry_pos + 26

gw = txt_w("GOOGLE", f_tag_lg)

cy += 38

draw.text((cx, cy), "548", font=f_big_num, fill=WHITE)
nw = txt_w("548", f_big_num)

cy += 108

arrow_up(cx + 2, cy + 8, 20, GREEN)

cy += 72

ry_pos += es_h + 24

bc_h = 200
rr(COL_R, ry_pos, COL_RW, bc_h, 14, fill=CARD_BG, border=CARD_BORDER, bw=1)
bx = COL_R + 34

by += 30

deltas = [128, 74, 94, 66, 34, 48, 41, 32, 44, 34]
labels = ["GOOG", "MSFT", "RHAT", "AMD", "DDOG", "INTC", "NVDA", "SUSE", "IBM", "SAP"]
max_d = 128

for i, (d, lbl) in enumerate(zip(deltas, labels)):

    # Value on top

    # Label
    txt_c(bxi + bar_w_i // 2, by + bar_max_h + 6, lbl, f_mono_xs, WHITE_FAINT)

# ============================================================
# FOOTER
# ============================================================
fy = H - 75
draw.line([(ML, fy), (MR, fy)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)

draw.text((ML, fy), "OSCI", font=f_footer_b, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
draw.text((ML + 60, fy + 2), "Open Source Contributor Index  |  Data: GitHub  |  License: GPL v3.0  |  March 2026",
          font=f_footer, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(MR, fy + 2, "osci.io", font=f_mono, fill=CYAN)

img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", quality=100)
print(f"Saved: {W}x{H}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Open Source Contributor Index — March 2026
Design Philosophy: Luminous Grid — Final Refined Pass

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 2400, 3400
BG = (10, 14, 28)
CARD_BG = (16, 22, 42)
CARD_BORDER = (30, 45, 80)

CYAN      = (0, 180, 255)
CYAN_DIM  = (0, 100, 160)
GREEN     = (0, 220, 120)
GREEN_DIM = (0, 160, 90)
AMBER     = (255, 180, 40)
WHITE     = (240, 245, 255)
WHITE_DIM = (160, 170, 195)
WHITE_FAINT = (80, 90, 120)
NAVY_LIGHT  = (22, 32, 58)
GOOGLE_ROW  = (14, 28, 58)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def F(n, s): return ImageFont.truetype(FD + n, s)

f_hero      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_tag       = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 15)
f_tag_lg    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 18)
f_section   = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 42)
f_big_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 100)
f_med_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 58)
f_sm_num    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 40)
f_metric    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 62)
f_th        = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_td        = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_td_b      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30)
f_tn        = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_tn_b      = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 28)
f_label     = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_label_sm  = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_mono      = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_mono_sm   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_mono_xs   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_mono_xxs  = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 13)
f_footer    = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_footer_b  = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_march     = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 32)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill=CARD_BG, border=None, bw=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=border, width=bw)

def tw(text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def txt_r(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt), y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def txt_c(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt)//2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def arrow_up(x, y, s, color):
    draw.polygon([(x, y+s), (x+s//2, y), (x+s, y+s)], fill=color)

# GRID
gc = (13, 17, 32)
for gx in range(0, W, 60):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill=gc, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 60):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=gc, width=1)

ML = 100; MR = W - 100; CW = MR - ML

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
y = 65

# Glow accent line
for i in range(10, 0, -1):
    a = int(30 * (1 - i/10))
    c = tuple(max(0, min(255, int(v * a / 255 + BG[j] * (1 - a/255)))) for j, v in enumerate(CYAN))
    draw.line([(ML, y - i//2), (ML + 200, y - i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
    draw.line([(ML, y + i//2), (ML + 200, y + i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
draw.line([(ML, y), (ML + 200, y)], fill=CYAN, width=3)

y += 24
draw.text((ML, y), "MONTHLY DATA REPORT", font=f_tag, fill=CYAN)
y += 34

draw.text((ML, y), "Open Source", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 92
draw.text((ML, y), "Contributor Index", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 100

draw.text((ML, y), "MARCH 2026", font=f_march, fill=CYAN)
mw = tw("MARCH 2026", f_march)
draw.line([(ML + mw + 20, y + 5), (ML + mw + 20, y + 30)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=2)
draw.text((ML + mw + 36, y + 4), "Ranking commercial organizations by employee open source contributions on GitHub",
          font=f_label, fill=WHITE_DIM)
y += 52
draw.line([(ML, y), (MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 32

# === KEY METRICS ===
metrics = [
    ("239",   "Organizations Tracked", WHITE),
    ("2,721", "Combined Active Contributors", CYAN),
    ("+595",  "New Contributors This Month", GREEN),
    ("20.3%", "Python — #1 Language", AMBER),
]
mw_e = CW // 4
for i, (val, lbl, col) in enumerate(metrics):
    mx = ML + i * mw_e
    if i > 0:
        draw.line([(mx, y + 2), (mx, y + 82)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
    ix = mx + (24 if i > 0 else 0)
    draw.text((ix, y), val, font=f_metric, fill=col)
    draw.text((ix, y + 70), lbl, font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_DIM)

y += 118
draw.line([(ML, y), (MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 40

# ============================================================
# TABLE
# ============================================================
draw.text((ML, y), "Top 10 Contributing Organizations", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
y += 60

C_R = ML + 12; C_O = ML + 75; C_A = ML + 680; C_AD = ML + 920
C_C = ML + 1200; C_CD = ML + 1460; C_B = ML + 1700; C_BE = MR - 20

hy = y
rr(ML, hy - 4, CW, 42, 6, fill=NAVY_LIGHT)
draw.text((C_R, hy), "#", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
draw.text((C_O, hy), "ORGANIZATION", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_A + 130, hy, "ACTIVE", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_AD + 110, hy, "MoM", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_C + 130, hy, "COMMUNITY", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_CD + 110, hy, "MoM", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_c((C_B + C_BE)//2, hy, "SCALE", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
y = hy + 54

orgs = [
    (1,"Google",548,128,1986,267),(2,"Microsoft",438,74,1189,174),
    (3,"Red Hat",432,94,1378,193),(4,"AMD",233,66,627,109),
    (5,"Datadog",221,34,411,58),(6,"Intel",217,48,707,82),
    (7,"NVIDIA",194,41,650,106),(8,"SUSE",158,32,353,51),
    (9,"IBM",140,44,616,133),(10,"SAP",140,34,378,54),
]
RH = 68; max_comm = 1986

for rank, org, active, ad, comm, cd in orgs:
    ry = y; g = rank == 1
    if g:
        rr(ML, ry - 12, CW, RH + 8, 10, fill=GOOGLE_ROW, border=CYAN, bw=2)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([ML, ry - 12, ML + 5, ry + RH - 4], radius=3, fill=CYAN)
    elif rank % 2 == 0:
        rr(ML, ry - 12, CW, RH + 8, 6, fill=(12, 17, 33))

    draw.text((C_R, ry), f"{rank:>2}", font=f_tn_b if g else f_tn, fill=CYAN if g else WHITE_FAINT)
    draw.text((C_O, ry), org, font=f_td_b if g else f_td, fill=WHITE if g else (205, 215, 235))
    txt_r(C_A + 130, ry, f"{active:,}", fnt=f_tn_b if g else f_tn, fill=WHITE if g else (195, 205, 228))
    arrow_up(C_AD + 36, ry + 12, 12, GREEN)
    draw.text((C_AD + 54, ry + 2), f"+{ad}", font=f_tn, fill=GREEN)
    txt_r(C_C + 130, ry, f"{comm:,}", fnt=f_tn, fill=WHITE_DIM)
    arrow_up(C_CD + 36, ry + 12, 12, GREEN_DIM)
    draw.text((C_CD + 54, ry + 2), f"+{cd}", font=f_tn, fill=GREEN_DIM)
    bw = C_BE - C_B
    rr(C_B, ry + 11, bw, 22, 11, fill=(18, 24, 44))
    fw = max(22, int(bw * comm / max_comm))
    rr(C_B, ry + 11, fw, 22, 11, fill=CYAN if g else (30, 70, 150))
    y += RH

y += 40

# ============================================================
# BOTTOM — 2 COLUMNS
# ============================================================
COL_L = ML; COL_LW = 1080; COL_R = ML + 1140; COL_RW = CW - 1140
bot_y = y

# === LEFT: LANGUAGES ===
ly = bot_y
draw.text((COL_L, ly), "Programming Language Distribution", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
ly += 62

langs = [
    ("Python",     20.3, CYAN),
    ("C++",        14.3, (0, 150, 220)),
    ("Go",         11.6, (0, 130, 195)),
    ("C",          10.9, (0, 112, 175)),
    ("TypeScript", 10.5, (0, 98, 158)),
    ("Java",        4.4, (0, 78, 135)),
]
max_p = 20.3; bs = COL_L + 260; be = COL_L + COL_LW - 20

for lang, pct, col in langs:
    draw.text((COL_L, ly + 5), lang, font=f_td, fill=WHITE_DIM)
    txt_r(bs - 18, ly + 5, f"{pct}%", fnt=f_tn_b, fill=col)
    fw_full = be - bs
    rr(bs, ly + 10, fw_full, 28, 14, fill=(18, 24, 44))
    fw_fill = max(28, int(fw_full * (pct / max_p)))
    rr(bs, ly + 10, fw_fill, 28, 14, fill=col)
    ly += 60

ly += 16
draw.text((COL_L, ly), "Systems languages (C++ & C) account for 25.2% of contributions", font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_FAINT)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Open Source Contributor Index — March 2026
Design Philosophy: Luminous Grid — Final Refined Pass
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math

W, H = 2400, 3400
BG = (10, 14, 28)
CARD_BG = (16, 22, 42)
CARD_BORDER = (30, 45, 80)

CYAN      = (0, 180, 255)
CYAN_DIM  = (0, 100, 160)
GREEN     = (0, 220, 120)
GREEN_DIM = (0, 160, 90)
AMBER     = (255, 180, 40)
WHITE     = (240, 245, 255)
WHITE_DIM = (160, 170, 195)
WHITE_FAINT = (80, 90, 120)
NAVY_LIGHT  = (22, 32, 58)
GOOGLE_ROW  = (14, 28, 58)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def F(n, s): return ImageFont.truetype(FD + n, s)

f_hero      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_tag       = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 15)
f_tag_lg    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 18)
f_section   = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 42)
f_big_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 100)
f_med_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 58)
f_sm_num    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 40)
f_metric    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 62)
f_th        = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_td        = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_td_b      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30)
f_tn        = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_tn_b      = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 28)
f_label     = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_label_sm  = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_mono      = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_mono_sm   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_mono_xs   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_mono_xxs  = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 13)
f_footer    = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_footer_b  = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_march     = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 32)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill=CARD_BG, border=None, bw=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=border, width=bw)

def tw(text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def txt_r(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt), y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def txt_c(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt)//2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def arrow_up(x, y, s, color):
    draw.polygon([(x, y+s), (x+s//2, y), (x+s, y+s)], fill=color)

# GRID
gc = (13, 17, 32)
for gx in range(0, W, 60):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill=gc, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 60):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=gc, width=1)

ML = 100; MR = W - 100; CW = MR - ML

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
y = 65

# Glow accent line
for i in range(10, 0, -1):
    a = int(30 * (1 - i/10))
    c = tuple(max(0, min(255, int(v * a / 255 + BG[j] * (1 - a/255)))) for j, v in enumerate(CYAN))
    draw.line([(ML, y - i//2), (ML + 200, y - i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
    draw.line([(ML, y + i//2), (ML + 200, y + i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
draw.line([(ML, y), (ML + 200, y)], fill=CYAN, width=3)

y += 24
draw.text((ML, y), "MONTHLY DATA REPORT", font=f_tag, fill=CYAN)
y += 34

draw.text((ML, y), "Open Source", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 92
draw.text((ML, y), "Contributor Index", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 100

draw.text((ML, y), "MARCH 2026", font=f_march, fill=CYAN)
mw = tw("MARCH 2026", f_march)
draw.line([(ML + mw + 20, y + 5), (ML + mw + 20, y + 30)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=2)
draw.text((ML + mw + 36, y + 4), "Ranking commercial organizations by employee open source contributions on GitHub",
          font=f_label, fill=WHITE_DIM)
y += 52
draw.line([(ML, y), (MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 32

# === KEY METRICS ===
metrics = [
    ("239",   "Organizations Tracked", WHITE),
    ("2,721", "Combined Active Contributors", CYAN),
    ("+595",  "New Contributors This Month", GREEN),
    ("20.3%", "Python — #1 Language", AMBER),
]
mw_e = CW // 4
for i, (val, lbl, col) in enumerate(metrics):
    mx = ML + i * mw_e
    if i > 0:
        draw.line([(mx, y + 2), (mx, y + 82)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
    ix = mx + (24 if i > 0 else 0)
    draw.text((ix, y), val, font=f_metric, fill=col)
    draw.text((ix, y + 70), lbl, font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_DIM)

y += 118
draw.line([(ML, y), (MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 40

# ============================================================
# TABLE
# ============================================================
draw.text((ML, y), "Top 10 Contributing Organizations", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
y += 60

C_R = ML + 12; C_O = ML + 75; C_A = ML + 680; C_AD = ML + 920
C_C = ML + 1200; C_CD = ML + 1460; C_B = ML + 1700; C_BE = MR - 20

hy = y
rr(ML, hy - 4, CW, 42, 6, fill=NAVY_LIGHT)
draw.text((C_R, hy), "#", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
draw.text((C_O, hy), "ORGANIZATION", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_A + 130, hy, "ACTIVE", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_AD + 110, hy, "MoM", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_C + 130, hy, "COMMUNITY", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_CD + 110, hy, "MoM", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_c((C_B + C_BE)//2, hy, "SCALE", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
y = hy + 54

orgs = [
    (1,"Google",548,128,1986,267),(2,"Microsoft",438,74,1189,174),
    (3,"Red Hat",432,94,1378,193),(4,"AMD",233,66,627,109),
    (5,"Datadog",221,34,411,58),(6,"Intel",217,48,707,82),
    (7,"NVIDIA",194,41,650,106),(8,"SUSE",158,32,353,51),
    (9,"IBM",140,44,616,133),(10,"SAP",140,34,378,54),
]
RH = 68; max_comm = 1986

for rank, org, active, ad, comm, cd in orgs:
    ry = y; g = rank == 1
    if g:
        rr(ML, ry - 12, CW, RH + 8, 10, fill=GOOGLE_ROW, border=CYAN, bw=2)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([ML, ry - 12, ML + 5, ry + RH - 4], radius=3, fill=CYAN)
    elif rank % 2 == 0:
        rr(ML, ry - 12, CW, RH + 8, 6, fill=(12, 17, 33))

    draw.text((C_R, ry), f"{rank:>2}", font=f_tn_b if g else f_tn, fill=CYAN if g else WHITE_FAINT)
    draw.text((C_O, ry), org, font=f_td_b if g else f_td, fill=WHITE if g else (205, 215, 235))
    txt_r(C_A + 130, ry, f"{active:,}", fnt=f_tn_b if g else f_tn, fill=WHITE if g else (195, 205, 228))
    arrow_up(C_AD + 36, ry + 12, 12, GREEN)
    draw.text((C_AD + 54, ry + 2), f"+{ad}", font=f_tn, fill=GREEN)
    txt_r(C_C + 130, ry, f"{comm:,}", fnt=f_tn, fill=WHITE_DIM)
    arrow_up(C_CD + 36, ry + 12, 12, GREEN_DIM)
    draw.text((C_CD + 54, ry + 2), f"+{cd}", font=f_tn, fill=GREEN_DIM)

"""
Open Source Contributor Index — March 2026
Design Philosophy: Luminous Grid — Final Refined Pass

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math

BG = (10, 14, 28)
CARD_BG = (16, 22, 42)
CARD_BORDER = (30, 45, 80)

CYAN      = (0, 180, 255)

GREEN_DIM = (0, 160, 90)

WHITE     = (240, 245, 255)
WHITE_DIM = (160, 170, 195)
WHITE_FAINT = (80, 90, 120)
NAVY_LIGHT  = (22, 32, 58)
GOOGLE_ROW  = (14, 28, 58)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def F(n, s): return ImageFont.truetype(FD + n, s)

f_hero      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_tag       = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 15)
f_tag_lg    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 18)
f_section   = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 42)
f_big_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 100)
f_med_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 58)
f_sm_num    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 40)
f_metric    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 62)
f_th        = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_td        = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_td_b      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30)
f_tn        = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_tn_b      = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 28)
f_label     = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_label_sm  = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_mono      = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_mono_sm   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 18)
f_mono_xs   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 15)
f_mono_xxs  = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 13)
f_footer    = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_footer_b  = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 22)
f_march     = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 32)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill=CARD_BG, border=None, bw=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=border, width=bw)

def tw(text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def txt_r(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt), y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def txt_c(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt)//2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def arrow_up(x, y, s, color):
    draw.polygon([(x, y+s), (x+s//2, y), (x+s, y+s)], fill=color)

# GRID
gc = (13, 17, 32)
for gx in range(0, W, 60):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill=gc, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 60):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=gc, width=1)

ML = 100; MR = W - 100; CW = MR - ML

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
y = 65

# Glow accent line
for i in range(10, 0, -1):
    a = int(30 * (1 - i/10))
    c = tuple(max(0, min(255, int(v * a / 255 + BG[j] * (1 - a/255)))) for j, v in enumerate(CYAN))
    draw.line([(ML, y - i//2), (ML + 200, y - i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
    draw.line([(ML, y + i//2), (ML + 200, y + i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
draw.line([(ML, y), (ML + 200, y)], fill=CYAN, width=3)

y += 24
draw.text((ML, y), "MONTHLY DATA REPORT", font=f_tag, fill=CYAN)
y += 34

draw.text((ML, y), "Open Source", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 92
draw.text((ML, y), "Contributor Index", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 100

draw.text((ML, y), "MARCH 2026", font=f_march, fill=CYAN)
mw = tw("MARCH 2026", f_march)
draw.line([(ML + mw + 20, y + 5), (ML + mw + 20, y + 30)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=2)
draw.text((ML + mw + 36, y + 4), "Ranking commercial organizations by employee open source contributions on GitHub",
          font=f_label, fill=WHITE_DIM)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Open Source Contributor Index — March 2026
Design Philosophy: Luminous Grid — Final Refined Pass
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math

W, H = 2400, 3400
BG = (10, 14, 28)
CARD_BG = (16, 22, 42)
CARD_BORDER = (30, 45, 80)

CYAN      = (0, 180, 255)
CYAN_DIM  = (0, 100, 160)
GREEN     = (0, 220, 120)
GREEN_DIM = (0, 160, 90)
AMBER     = (255, 180, 40)
WHITE     = (240, 245, 255)
WHITE_DIM = (160, 170, 195)
WHITE_FAINT = (80, 90, 120)
NAVY_LIGHT  = (22, 32, 58)
GOOGLE_ROW  = (14, 28, 58)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def F(n, s): return ImageFont.truetype(FD + n, s)

f_hero      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_tag       = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 15)
f_tag_lg    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 18)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Open Source Contributor Index — March 2026
Design Philosophy: Luminous Grid — Museum-Quality Final
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 2400, 3400
BG = (10, 14, 28)
CARD_BG = (16, 22, 42)
CARD_BORDER = (30, 45, 80)

CYAN      = (0, 180, 255)
GREEN     = (0, 220, 120)
GREEN_DIM = (0, 160, 90)
AMBER     = (255, 180, 40)
WHITE     = (240, 245, 255)
WHITE_DIM = (160, 170, 195)
WHITE_FAINT = (80, 90, 120)
NAVY_LIGHT  = (22, 32, 58)
GOOGLE_ROW  = (14, 28, 58)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def F(n, s): return ImageFont.truetype(FD + n, s)

f_hero      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 86)
f_tag       = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 15)
f_tag_lg    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 18)
f_section   = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_big_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 104)
f_med_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 60)
f_sm_num    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 42)
f_metric    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 66)
f_th        = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 25)
f_td        = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_td_b      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 32)
f_tn        = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_tn_b      = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
f_label     = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_label_sm  = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_mono      = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_mono_sm   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_mono_xs   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 16)
f_mono_xxs  = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 14)
f_footer    = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_footer_b  = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_march     = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 34)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill=CARD_BG, border=None, bw=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=border, width=bw)

def tw(text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def txt_r(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt), y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def txt_c(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt)//2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def arrow_up(x, y, s, color):
    draw.polygon([(x, y+s), (x+s//2, y), (x+s, y+s)], fill=color)

# GRID
gc = (13, 17, 32)
for gx in range(0, W, 60):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill=gc, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 60):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=gc, width=1)

ML = 100; MR = W - 100; CW = MR - ML

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
y = 70

# Glow accent
for i in range(12, 0, -1):
    a = int(35 * (1 - i/12))
    c = tuple(max(0,min(255, int(v*a/255 + BG[j]*(1-a/255)))) for j,v in enumerate(CYAN))
    draw.line([(ML, y-i//2),(ML+220, y-i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
    draw.line([(ML, y+i//2),(ML+220, y+i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
draw.line([(ML, y),(ML+220, y)], fill=CYAN, width=3)

y += 26
draw.text((ML, y), "MONTHLY DATA REPORT", font=f_tag, fill=CYAN)
y += 36

draw.text((ML, y), "Open Source", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 96
draw.text((ML, y), "Contributor Index", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 106

draw.text((ML, y), "MARCH 2026", font=f_march, fill=CYAN)
mw = tw("MARCH 2026", f_march)
draw.line([(ML+mw+22, y+6),(ML+mw+22, y+32)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=2)
draw.text((ML+mw+40, y+5), "Ranking commercial organizations by employee open source contributions on GitHub",
          font=f_label, fill=WHITE_DIM)
y += 56
draw.line([(ML, y),(MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 36

# === KEY METRICS ===
metrics = [
    ("239",   "Organizations Tracked", WHITE),
    ("2,721", "Combined Active Contributors", CYAN),
    ("+595",  "New Contributors This Month", GREEN),
    ("20.3%", "Python — #1 Language", AMBER),
]
mw_e = CW // 4
for i, (val, lbl, col) in enumerate(metrics):
    mx = ML + i * mw_e
    if i > 0:
        draw.line([(mx, y+2),(mx, y+88)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
    ix = mx + (28 if i > 0 else 0)
    draw.text((ix, y), val, font=f_metric, fill=col)
    draw.text((ix, y+74), lbl, font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_DIM)

y += 128
draw.line([(ML, y),(MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 44

# ============================================================
# TABLE
# ============================================================
draw.text((ML, y), "Top 10 Contributing Organizations", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
y += 66

C_R=ML+14; C_O=ML+80; C_A=ML+700; C_AD=ML+950; C_C=ML+1230; C_CD=ML+1500; C_B=ML+1740; C_BE=MR-20

hy = y
rr(ML, hy-4, CW, 44, 6, fill=NAVY_LIGHT)
draw.text((C_R, hy+2), "#", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
draw.text((C_O, hy+2), "ORGANIZATION", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_A+140, hy+2, "ACTIVE", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_AD+120, hy+2, "MoM", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_C+140, hy+2, "COMMUNITY", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_CD+120, hy+2, "MoM", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_c((C_B+C_BE)//2, hy+2, "SCALE", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
y = hy + 56

orgs = [
    (1,"Google",548,128,1986,267),(2,"Microsoft",438,74,1189,174),
    (3,"Red Hat",432,94,1378,193),(4,"AMD",233,66,627,109),
    (5,"Datadog",221,34,411,58),(6,"Intel",217,48,707,82),
    (7,"NVIDIA",194,41,650,106),(8,"SUSE",158,32,353,51),
    (9,"IBM",140,44,616,133),(10,"SAP",140,34,378,54),
]
RH = 74; max_comm = 1986

for rank, org, active, ad, comm, cd in orgs:
    ry = y; g = rank == 1
    if g:
        rr(ML, ry-14, CW, RH+10, 10, fill=GOOGLE_ROW, border=CYAN, bw=2)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([ML, ry-14, ML+5, ry+RH-4], radius=3, fill=CYAN)
    elif rank % 2 == 0:
        rr(ML, ry-14, CW, RH+10, 6, fill=(12,17,33))

    draw.text((C_R, ry), f"{rank:>2}", font=f_tn_b if g else f_tn, fill=CYAN if g else WHITE_FAINT)
    draw.text((C_O, ry), org, font=f_td_b if g else f_td, fill=WHITE if g else (205,215,235))
    txt_r(C_A+140, ry, f"{active:,}", fnt=f_tn_b if g else f_tn, fill=WHITE if g else (195,205,228))
    arrow_up(C_AD+38, ry+14, 13, GREEN)
    draw.text((C_AD+58, ry+2), f"+{ad}", font=f_tn, fill=GREEN)
    txt_r(C_C+140, ry, f"{comm:,}", fnt=f_tn, fill=WHITE_DIM)
    arrow_up(C_CD+38, ry+14, 13, GREEN_DIM)
    draw.text((C_CD+58, ry+2), f"+{cd}", font=f_tn, fill=GREEN_DIM)
    bw_ = C_BE - C_B
    rr(C_B, ry+14, bw_, 24, 12, fill=(18,24,44))
    fw = max(24, int(bw_ * comm / max_comm))
    rr(C_B, ry+14, fw, 24, 12, fill=CYAN if g else (30,70,150))
    y += RH

y += 50

# ============================================================
# BOTTOM — 2 COLUMNS
# ============================================================
COL_L = ML; COL_LW = 1080; COL_R = ML + 1140; COL_RW = CW - 1140
bot_y = y

# =========================
# LEFT: LANGUAGES
# =========================
ly = bot_y
draw.text((COL_L, ly), "Programming Language Distribution", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
ly += 68

langs = [
    ("Python",     20.3, CYAN),
    ("C++",        14.3, (0,150,220)),
    ("Go",         11.6, (0,130,195)),
    ("C",          10.9, (0,112,175)),
    ("TypeScript", 10.5, (0,98,158)),
    ("Java",        4.4, (0,78,135)),
]
max_p = 20.3; bs = COL_L + 270; be_ = COL_L + COL_LW - 20

for lang, pct, col in langs:
    draw.text((COL_L, ly+6), lang, font=f_td, fill=WHITE_DIM)
    txt_r(bs-20, ly+6, f"{pct}%", fnt=f_tn_b, fill=col)
    fwf = be_ - bs
    rr(bs, ly+12, fwf, 28, 14, fill=(18,24,44))
    fw = max(28, int(fwf * (pct/max_p)))
    rr(bs, ly+12, fw, 28, 14, fill=col)
    ly += 66

ly += 18
draw.text((COL_L, ly), "Systems languages (C++ & C) account for 25.2% of contributions", font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
ly += 28
draw.text((COL_L, ly), "Python leads driven by AI/ML, data science & cloud-native tooling", font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_FAINT)

# =========================
# LEFT: LICENSES
# =========================
ly += 65

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Open Source Contributor Index — March 2026
Design Philosophy: Luminous Grid — Museum-Quality Final
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 2400, 3400
BG = (10, 14, 28)
CARD_BG = (16, 22, 42)
CARD_BORDER = (30, 45, 80)

CYAN      = (0, 180, 255)
GREEN     = (0, 220, 120)
GREEN_DIM = (0, 160, 90)
AMBER     = (255, 180, 40)
WHITE     = (240, 245, 255)
WHITE_DIM = (160, 170, 195)
WHITE_FAINT = (80, 90, 120)
NAVY_LIGHT  = (22, 32, 58)
GOOGLE_ROW  = (14, 28, 58)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def F(n, s): return ImageFont.truetype(FD + n, s)

f_hero      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 86)
f_tag       = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 15)
f_tag_lg    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 18)
f_section   = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_big_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 104)
f_med_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 60)
f_sm_num    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 42)
f_metric    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 66)
f_th        = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 25)
f_td        = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_td_b      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 32)
f_tn        = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_tn_b      = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
f_label     = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_label_sm  = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_mono      = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_mono_sm   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_mono_xs   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 16)
f_mono_xxs  = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 14)
f_footer    = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_footer_b  = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_march     = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 34)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill=CARD_BG, border=None, bw=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=border, width=bw)

def tw(text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def txt_r(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt), y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def txt_c(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt)//2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def arrow_up(x, y, s, color):
    draw.polygon([(x, y+s), (x+s//2, y), (x+s, y+s)], fill=color)

# GRID
gc = (13, 17, 32)
for gx in range(0, W, 60):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill=gc, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 60):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=gc, width=1)

ML = 100; MR = W - 100; CW = MR - ML

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
y = 70

# Glow accent
for i in range(12, 0, -1):
    a = int(35 * (1 - i/12))
    c = tuple(max(0,min(255, int(v*a/255 + BG[j]*(1-a/255)))) for j,v in enumerate(CYAN))
    draw.line([(ML, y-i//2),(ML+220, y-i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
    draw.line([(ML, y+i//2),(ML+220, y+i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
draw.line([(ML, y),(ML+220, y)], fill=CYAN, width=3)

y += 26
draw.text((ML, y), "MONTHLY DATA REPORT", font=f_tag, fill=CYAN)
y += 36

draw.text((ML, y), "Open Source", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 96
draw.text((ML, y), "Contributor Index", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 106

draw.text((ML, y), "MARCH 2026", font=f_march, fill=CYAN)
mw = tw("MARCH 2026", f_march)
draw.line([(ML+mw+22, y+6),(ML+mw+22, y+32)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=2)
draw.text((ML+mw+40, y+5), "Ranking commercial organizations by employee open source contributions on GitHub",
          font=f_label, fill=WHITE_DIM)
y += 56
draw.line([(ML, y),(MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 36

# === KEY METRICS ===
metrics = [
    ("239",   "Organizations Tracked", WHITE),
    ("2,721", "Combined Active Contributors", CYAN),
    ("+595",  "New Contributors This Month", GREEN),
    ("20.3%", "Python — #1 Language", AMBER),
]
mw_e = CW // 4
for i, (val, lbl, col) in enumerate(metrics):
    mx = ML + i * mw_e
    if i > 0:
        draw.line([(mx, y+2),(mx, y+88)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
    ix = mx + (28 if i > 0 else 0)
    draw.text((ix, y), val, font=f_metric, fill=col)
    draw.text((ix, y+74), lbl, font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_DIM)

y += 128
draw.line([(ML, y),(MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 44

# ============================================================
# TABLE
# ============================================================
draw.text((ML, y), "Top 10 Contributing Organizations", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
y += 66

C_R=ML+14; C_O=ML+80; C_A=ML+700; C_AD=ML+950; C_C=ML+1230; C_CD=ML+1500; C_B=ML+1740; C_BE=MR-20

hy = y
rr(ML, hy-4, CW, 44, 6, fill=NAVY_LIGHT)
draw.text((C_R, hy+2), "#", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
draw.text((C_O, hy+2), "ORGANIZATION", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_A+140, hy+2, "ACTIVE", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_AD+120, hy+2, "MoM", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_C+140, hy+2, "COMMUNITY", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_CD+120, hy+2, "MoM", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_c((C_B+C_BE)//2, hy+2, "SCALE", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
y = hy + 56

orgs = [
    (1,"Google",548,128,1986,267),(2,"Microsoft",438,74,1189,174),
    (3,"Red Hat",432,94,1378,193),(4,"AMD",233,66,627,109),
    (5,"Datadog",221,34,411,58),(6,"Intel",217,48,707,82),
    (7,"NVIDIA",194,41,650,106),(8,"SUSE",158,32,353,51),
    (9,"IBM",140,44,616,133),(10,"SAP",140,34,378,54),
]
RH = 74; max_comm = 1986

for rank, org, active, ad, comm, cd in orgs:
    ry = y; g = rank == 1
    if g:
        rr(ML, ry-14, CW, RH+10, 10, fill=GOOGLE_ROW, border=CYAN, bw=2)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([ML, ry-14, ML+5, ry+RH-4], radius=3, fill=CYAN)
    elif rank % 2 == 0:
        rr(ML, ry-14, CW, RH+10, 6, fill=(12,17,33))

    draw.text((C_R, ry), f"{rank:>2}", font=f_tn_b if g else f_tn, fill=CYAN if g else WHITE_FAINT)
    draw.text((C_O, ry), org, font=f_td_b if g else f_td, fill=WHITE if g else (205,215,235))
    txt_r(C_A+140, ry, f"{active:,}", fnt=f_tn_b if g else f_tn, fill=WHITE if g else (195,205,228))
    arrow_up(C_AD+38, ry+14, 13, GREEN)
    draw.text((C_AD+58, ry+2), f"+{ad}", font=f_tn, fill=GREEN)
    txt_r(C_C+140, ry, f"{comm:,}", fnt=f_tn, fill=WHITE_DIM)
    arrow_up(C_CD+38, ry+14, 13, GREEN_DIM)
    draw.text((C_CD+58, ry+2), f"+{cd}", font=f_tn, fill=GREEN_DIM)
    bw_ = C_BE - C_B
    rr(C_B, ry+14, bw_, 24, 12, fill=(18,24,44))
    fw = max(24, int(bw_ * comm / max_comm))
    rr(C_B, ry+14, fw, 24, 12, fill=CYAN if g else (30,70,150))
    y += RH

y += 50

# ============================================================
# BOTTOM — 2 COLUMNS
# ============================================================
COL_L = ML; COL_LW = 1080; COL_R = ML + 1140; COL_RW = CW - 1140
bot_y = y

# =========================
# LEFT: LANGUAGES
# =========================

fy = H - 80

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Open Source Contributor Index — March 2026
Design Philosophy: Luminous Grid — Museum-Quality Final
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 2400, 3400
BG = (10, 14, 28)
CARD_BG = (16, 22, 42)
CARD_BORDER = (30, 45, 80)

CYAN      = (0, 180, 255)
GREEN     = (0, 220, 120)
GREEN_DIM = (0, 160, 90)
AMBER     = (255, 180, 40)
WHITE     = (240, 245, 255)
WHITE_DIM = (160, 170, 195)
WHITE_FAINT = (80, 90, 120)
NAVY_LIGHT  = (22, 32, 58)
GOOGLE_ROW  = (14, 28, 58)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def F(n, s): return ImageFont.truetype(FD + n, s)

f_hero      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 86)
f_tag       = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 15)
f_tag_lg    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 18)
f_section   = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_big_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 104)
f_med_num   = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 60)
f_sm_num    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 42)
f_metric    = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 66)
f_th        = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 25)
f_td        = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_td_b      = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 32)
f_tn        = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_tn_b      = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
f_label     = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_label_sm  = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_mono      = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_mono_sm   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 20)
f_mono_xs   = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 16)
f_mono_xxs  = F("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 14)
f_footer    = F("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_footer_b  = F("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 24)
f_march     = F("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 34)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill=CARD_BG, border=None, bw=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=border, width=bw)

def tw(text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def txt_r(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt), y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def txt_c(x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x - tw(text, fnt)//2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

def arrow_up(x, y, s, color):
    draw.polygon([(x, y+s), (x+s//2, y), (x+s, y+s)], fill=color)

# GRID
gc = (13, 17, 32)
for gx in range(0, W, 60):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill=gc, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 60):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=gc, width=1)

ML = 100; MR = W - 100; CW = MR - ML

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
y = 70

# Glow accent
for i in range(12, 0, -1):
    a = int(35 * (1 - i/12))
    c = tuple(max(0,min(255, int(v*a/255 + BG[j]*(1-a/255)))) for j,v in enumerate(CYAN))
    draw.line([(ML, y-i//2),(ML+220, y-i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
    draw.line([(ML, y+i//2),(ML+220, y+i//2)], fill=c, width=1)
draw.line([(ML, y),(ML+220, y)], fill=CYAN, width=3)

y += 26
draw.text((ML, y), "MONTHLY DATA REPORT", font=f_tag, fill=CYAN)
y += 36

draw.text((ML, y), "Open Source", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 96
draw.text((ML, y), "Contributor Index", font=f_hero, fill=WHITE)
y += 106

draw.text((ML, y), "MARCH 2026", font=f_march, fill=CYAN)
mw = tw("MARCH 2026", f_march)
draw.line([(ML+mw+22, y+6),(ML+mw+22, y+32)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=2)
draw.text((ML+mw+40, y+5), "Ranking commercial organizations by employee open source contributions on GitHub",
          font=f_label, fill=WHITE_DIM)
y += 56
draw.line([(ML, y),(MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 36

# === KEY METRICS ===
metrics = [
    ("239",   "Organizations Tracked", WHITE),
    ("2,721", "Combined Active Contributors", CYAN),
    ("+595",  "New Contributors This Month", GREEN),
    ("20.3%", "Python — #1 Language", AMBER),
]
mw_e = CW // 4
for i, (val, lbl, col) in enumerate(metrics):
    mx = ML + i * mw_e
    if i > 0:
        draw.line([(mx, y+2),(mx, y+88)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
    ix = mx + (28 if i > 0 else 0)
    draw.text((ix, y), val, font=f_metric, fill=col)
    draw.text((ix, y+74), lbl, font=f_label_sm, fill=WHITE_DIM)

y += 128
draw.line([(ML, y),(MR, y)], fill=CARD_BORDER, width=1)
y += 44

# ============================================================
# TABLE
# ============================================================
draw.text((ML, y), "Top 10 Contributing Organizations", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
y += 66

C_R=ML+14; C_O=ML+80; C_A=ML+700; C_AD=ML+950; C_C=ML+1230; C_CD=ML+1500; C_B=ML+1740; C_BE=MR-20

hy = y
rr(ML, hy-4, CW, 44, 6, fill=NAVY_LIGHT)
draw.text((C_R, hy+2), "#", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
draw.text((C_O, hy+2), "ORGANIZATION", font=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_A+140, hy+2, "ACTIVE", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_AD+120, hy+2, "MoM", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_C+140, hy+2, "COMMUNITY", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_r(C_CD+120, hy+2, "MoM", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
txt_c((C_B+C_BE)//2, hy+2, "SCALE", fnt=f_th, fill=WHITE_FAINT)
y = hy + 56

orgs = [
    (1,"Google",548,128,1986,267),(2,"Microsoft",438,74,1189,174),
    (3,"Red Hat",432,94,1378,193),(4,"AMD",233,66,627,109),
    (5,"Datadog",221,34,411,58),(6,"Intel",217,48,707,82),
    (7,"NVIDIA",194,41,650,106),(8,"SUSE",158,32,353,51),
    (9,"IBM",140,44,616,133),(10,"SAP",140,34,378,54),
]
RH = 74; max_comm = 1986

for rank, org, active, ad, comm, cd in orgs:
    ry = y; g = rank == 1
    if g:
        rr(ML, ry-14, CW, RH+10, 10, fill=GOOGLE_ROW, border=CYAN, bw=2)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([ML, ry-14, ML+5, ry+RH-4], radius=3, fill=CYAN)
    elif rank % 2 == 0:
